about: Organic objects for SDF modeling (#42). No expected bounding box: parts are scored by the visual judge (eval/judge.py) against the request. 'subject' names the object (the SDF examples must not include it, tests/test_sdf.py); 'search' is what the thingiverse config searches for. Requests read like the gate's organic_spec: what the object looks like and how big it is.

cases.subject: cat
cases.request: A sitting cat about 50 mm tall, tail curled around its front paws, ears pointing up.

cases.subject: horse
cases.request: A standing horse figurine, 60 mm tall, four legs, long neck and head raised, a tail hanging down.

cases.subject: frog
cases.request: A frog sitting on its folded back legs, about 40 mm long, with big bulging eyes on top of its head.

cases.subject: tulip
cases.request: A tulip flower 80 mm tall: a cup-shaped bloom of petals on a straight stem with two long leaves, on a small round base.

cases.subject: octopus
cases.request: A cartoon octopus 50 mm tall: a round head and eight curling tentacles spread around it on the ground.

cases.subject: owl
cases.request: An owl figurine 50 mm tall: an egg-shaped body, a round face with two large eyes and a small beak, ear tufts, wings folded at the sides.

cases.subject: rubber duck
cases.request: A rubber duck, 45 mm tall, with a flat bottom so it stands.

cases.subject: dinosaur
cases.request: A long-necked dinosaur (brontosaurus) 80 mm long: a heavy body on four pillar legs, a long neck with a small head, and a long tail.

cases.subject: hand
cases.request: A human hand, palm open with fingers spread, standing upright on its wrist, 90 mm tall.

cases.subject: apple
cases.request: An apple 50 mm wide with a short stem and one leaf.

cases.subject: dolphin
cases.request: A dolphin leaping in an arc, 70 mm long, with a dorsal fin, flippers and a tail fluke, the tail touching a small round base.

cases.subject: turtle
cases.request: A turtle 60 mm long: a domed shell, four stubby legs, a head poking out the front and a short tail.

cases.subject: seahorse
cases.request: A seahorse 70 mm tall, upright, with a curled tail touching a small round base, a long snout and a ridged belly.

cases.subject: crab
cases.request: A crab 60 mm wide: a flat oval shell, two raised claws at the front, four legs on each side, and eyes on short stalks.

cases.subject: starfish
cases.request: A starfish 70 mm across with five thick arms tapering to rounded tips, lying flat, with a bumpy top.

cases.subject: shark
cases.request: A shark 80 mm long, swimming, on a small stand: a pointed snout, a tall dorsal fin, two side fins and a forked tail.

cases.subject: walrus
cases.request: A walrus 55 mm tall, resting on its belly with its front flippers on the ground, a round head, whiskered snout and two long tusks pointing down.

cases.subject: chicken
cases.request: A chicken 50 mm tall standing on two legs, a round body, a comb on top of its head, a small beak and tail feathers raised at the back.

cases.subject: llama
cases.request: A standing llama 75 mm tall: four thin legs, a long upright neck, a small head with tall pointed ears and a fluffy body.

cases.subject: parrot
cases.request: A parrot 60 mm tall perched upright on a short branch, with a curved hooked beak, folded wings and a long tail hanging down.

cases.subject: pineapple
cases.request: A pineapple 80 mm tall: an oval fruit with a criss-cross scaled surface and a crown of spiky leaves on top.

cases.subject: banana
cases.request: A single banana 90 mm long, curved, with a short stem at one end, lying on its side.

cases.subject: strawberry
cases.request: A strawberry 40 mm tall, heart-shaped, with small seed dimples over its surface and a crown of leaves on top.

cases.subject: avocado
cases.request: Half an avocado 70 mm long, cut side up, lying flat, with the round pit sitting in the middle.

cases.subject: garlic
cases.request: A garlic bulb 45 mm tall: plump cloves bulging around a rounded base, gathered into a pointed tip at the top.

cases.subject: rose
cases.request: A single rose 90 mm tall: a tight spiral bloom of petals on a straight stem with two leaves, on a small round base.

cases.subject: palm
cases.request: A palm tree 90 mm tall: a slightly curved ringed trunk on a small round base, with long drooping fronds spreading from the top.

cases.subject: tooth
cases.request: A molar tooth 40 mm tall, standing on its two roots, with a wide crown and a bumpy top.

cases.subject: croissant
cases.request: A croissant 80 mm long, crescent-shaped, with rolled layers that swell in the middle and taper to the two curved ends.

cases.subject: cupcake
cases.request: A cupcake 50 mm tall: a ridged paper cup, a swirl of frosting on top and a cherry at the peak.
